next_step: POC: run 48-hour high-concurrency spike test, evaluate locale-aware tone controls, finalize SSO/KMS checklist
notes:
Lead: Auralynx builds multilingual contact center tooling focused on European telco and fintech customers. Primary ask: automated agent assist + ticket summarization across 7 locales with locale-aware tone and regulatory routing (FR/DE data residency). Current POC scope: ingestion of transcribed voice + asynchronous chat, real-time tool-calling for CRM lookups, and a fallback routing policy during spikes.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Owner: Samira) — they described high variance in traffic (daily spikes tied to billing cycles). Mentioned: "If we lose tone in translations, CSAT drops 8-12%".
- 2026-02-24: Deep-dive w/ SE (Diego) — shared sample transcripts (EN/FR/DE/ES/IT/PL/NO). Discussed prefix caching for repetitive billing queries. Action: they will provide 10k annotated utterances. (ff_2026_02_24_auralynx_intro)
- 2026-03-03: POC kickoff — agreed on 2-week POC with 48-hr spike stress test and a quality eval set. Security checklist sent; awaiting SSO metadata and KMS key policy (drive:/Security/Responses/auralynx-security-faq-2026.xlsx). (ff_2026_03_03_poc_kickoff)
- 2026-03-05: Internal demo with their platform team — noted latency SLO target 150ms median for agent-assist paths, throughput target 400 concurrent sessions in peak. They flagged interest in Redwood's batching + KV cache behavior to reduce costs.

Requirements summary:
- Workloads: mostly short agent-turn generation and ticket summarization (avg response 48 tokens), plus occasional reranking for VR triage.
- Latency: median <=150ms for agent-assist; p99 target <=600ms for end-to-end including tool calls.
- Throughput: sustain 350-450 concurrent interactive sessions; burstable to 1,200 for up to 2 hours during billing cycles.
- Models: prefer open models with quantized variants; willing to test Redwood-verified small-medium models for cost control; want automated fallback to larger model for critical escalations.
- Routing: geo-aware region routing (EU primary), auto-failover to US dedicated capacity during region outage, plus per-customer residency controls.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, audit logs retention 1 year, customer-managed KMS for PII-encrypted KV cache.

POC success metrics:
- Accuracy: ticket summarization ROUGE-L improvement >= 15% vs current rule-based baseline on their eval set.
- Cost: per-session token cost <= their threshold (TBD in pricing thread).
- Reliability: pass 48-hour high-concurrency spike with <0.5% error rate and no SLA violations.
- Tone fidelity: human A/B of translated responses must prefer Redwood outputs >= 60% on locale-aware tone metric.

Quoted lines from platform lead: "We need translations that keep brand voice. A literal translation is not enough."

Next steps (short):
- Get SSO metadata by 2026-03-10 (BLOCKER).
- Provide annotated 10k utterances via shared drive by 2026-03-12.
- Run POC spike test 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-17.
- Follow-up: pricing + dedicated capacity proposal after successful spike.

Internal notes/asks for AE/SE:
- Evaluate KMS integration options and timeline for customer-managed keys.
- Validate p99 latency on EU region under our batching configs; run a small sim with their transcripts.
- Prep pricing scenarios: (a) Hosted with caching + optimize, (b) Dedicated reserved pool for 2x peak, (c) Hybrid EU Private for data residency.
